note: Section 31 of the Federal Data Protection Act lets a claim count in a credit score only after at least two written reminders, the first at least four weeks earlier, written as 28 days from a reminder sent at the due date; the credit bureaus' code of conduct on deletion (January 2021) deletes a settled claim three years to the day after it's settled, and SCHUFA's own information sheet gives three years to the day after settlement.

sources.title: Bundesdatenschutzgesetz § 31, Schutz des Wirtschaftsverkehrs bei Scoring und Bonitätsauskünften
